meta.title: Pricing | RinKuzu
meta.description: RinKuzu pricing: a generous free plan for PDF quiz generation and adaptive practice, plus affordable premium plans that unlock private quizzes, higher limits, and advanced stats.

hero.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
hero.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready for full adaptive learning.

faqs.q: What is included in the free plan?
faqs.a: The free plan includes PDF-to-quiz generation, adaptive practice sessions, mastery tracking, Bloom's Taxonomy level practice, community quiz browsing, and a personal dashboard — with daily usage limits. Everything you need to get started with AI-powered learning.
Premium unlocks private quizzes, higher daily limits for AI features, and advanced statistics. You pay once for the plan duration (monthly, 6-month, yearly, or lifetime) — no auto-renewal surprises.

faqs.q: Can I switch plans at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can purchase a premium plan whenever you are ready. Your current access remains until it ends.

faqs.q: Is there a student or educator discount?
faqs.a: Contact us at support@rinkuzu.app for education pricing. We believe AI-powered learning should be accessible to everyone.

cta.title: Not sure which plan is right for you?
cta.subtitle: Start with the free plan, no credit card required. Upgrade anytime.
